title: Freestyle target runs and the Objectives mode
summary: All four Freestyle objective types now play on furyremastered.com: Hit Every Green/Red Target joins Bust 10 Different Combos and Score Stunt Points, so gold is now reachable in both Freestyle championships. Single Player → Freestyle Objectives lets you play any course's objectives outside a championship, and completed objectives still save.
details: Recovered from the exact build: each target is a one-time 5 ft trigger sphere marked by a 10 ft flat target that spins and bobs (cherry.MOT); a hit adds bonus points and seconds, plays the pickup sound and shows "Target Collected" for 1 s; the last shows "All Targets Collected" for 5 s and ends the run. Any completed objective adds the seconds left × 100 to the score. Each objective has its own start position. The trophy, reward and unlock arrive the moment the completed count reaches the threshold (Amateur 24/30/36, Pro 18/24/30).
The courses' objective archives (11) were uploaded to the hosted content and verified.

Verification: unit tests, a new browser test that plays a championship green run and a standalone red run with real trigger hits, all 22 target runs loaded in a private check, and nearby menu/objective tests pass on host Chromium; the new test also passed against the live site. PRs #357, #359, #362; the championship browser test was updated for the Hall of Fame name entry (#366).
limitation: target explosions are not drawn; targets show as screen tags and minimap dots instead of the original compass; the hit test checks the ATV and rider positions, not every body; Select Objective is a front-end page; env03, env07 and free05 have no objective archive.
